newsitem.title: USA: Retsinas says his U.S. thrift post temporary.
newsitem.headline: Retsinas says his U.S. thrift post temporary.

text.p: Nicolas Retsinas, sworn in Thursday as head of the agency that oversees savings and loans, said he will serve on an interim basis and that he is not a candidate to permanently fill that spot.
The period for which he will oversee the Office of Thrift Supervision is 120 days, he said in a telephone interview.
"The intent of the administration is to nominate a permanent director in January," Retsinas said.
He will continue in his position as assistant secretary for housing at the Department of Housing and Urban Development at the same time as his new post.
"No, I am not a candidate for permanent director," Retsinas said.

"The thrift industry is very healthy, certainly their profitability has increased substantially over the last several years," he said. "I believe the institutions are generally very sound," and that recent legislation will further help profitability, Retsinas added.
Legislation passed at the end of the Congressional session to boost the Savings Association Insurance Fund, which insures deposits at thrifts.
